title: Cyber Operation: Korean-language malware support
summary: OpenAI banned Korean-language accounts using AI for malware development support, debugging, phishing, and credential-theft workflows.
body: OpenAI banned Korean-language accounts using AI for malware development support, debugging, phishing, and credential-theft workflows.
summaryZh: OpenAI封禁了使用韩语的恶意账户，这些账户利用AI技术支持恶意软件开发、代码调试、网络钓鱼以及凭据窃取等网络攻击工作流。原始信息显示：OpenAI banned Korean-language accounts using AI for malware development support, debugging, phishing, and credential-theft workflows.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Cyber Operation: Korean-language malware support”。其重要性主要体现在：展示了恶意攻击者如何利用大模型和自动化工作流来辅助编写恶意软件，体现了智能体和代码生成技术的安全隐患。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
